dialogues.speaker: Maki
dialogues.text: That's right. This is the "eternity" that the Electro Archon is pursuing. It seems like you already know something about Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Maki
dialogues.text: You can have this small floral ornament. Even though it's not formed from divine powers, it should still be able to accompany you for a long time. I wish you good luck.
